generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
Conditional tenders are not accepted
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
The Tenderer should furnish all the necessary original documents mentioned above at the time of evaluation of Bid
The tenderer should maintain the work/Supply during the defective liability period for 2 years after completion of the work
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders.
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act and a sum of amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards construction labour fund as per govt order.
This work should be Inspected by the 3rd party Agency and after getting 3rd party report satisfactory payment will be made.
The earnest money deposit may be forfeited if the documents submitted the Tenderer found to misleading/forged or fake.
THE PAYMENT SHOULD PAID AS PER AVAILABILITY OF FUNDS AFTER COMPLETION OF WORK SATISFACTORY.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of not less than estimated cost of the work in last five years. Turnover certificate duly certified by CA during last 5 years 2021-22 to 2025-26 With Valid UDIN Number

Uploading of site inspection report from CMC ILKAL
Contractor Name,Details, address, Email Id Or Whatsapp mobile no.
Additional performance Security Below DD for Unbalanced Tenders in the Form of DD/FDR/BC from NationalizedOr Scheduled Bank should be scanned and upload
